summary: Acer Predator Neo 16 with Intel Core i9-14900HX, 32GB DDR5 RAM, 2x 1TB NVMe M.2 (with an additional M.2), RTX 4070, Windows 11. The system is experiencing Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) crashes primarily caused by the KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED error code.
detected_fault: The use of anti-cheat software, particularly those that run at kernel level, may be causing the BSODs.
suggested_solution: Disable anti-cheat software and monitor system performance to determine if it is causing the BSODs.
